name: r2e_reaction_center_residual_v2_train_geometry
definition: For each clean2023 training reaction, measure norm(aux_to_hidden(center_features)) / norm(base_hidden_preactivation) before GELU in the already-trained residual-v2 production model.
candidate_cap_derivation: Use rounded train-only p25/p50/p90-scale caps 0.075, 0.10, 0.16. No Rhea128->141 query, slice, metric or label is used to choose these values.
